# prompt-injection-guard

> Screen user input and retrieved content for prompt injection with explainable rules, Unicode obfuscation removal including tag characters, and an optional classifier that can only raise the score Python package `trysac-prompt-injection-guard`, import name `prompt_injection_guard`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
